faq.question: What does Tiziri mean?
faq.answer: Tiziri is associated with the Amazigh form تِيزِيرِي, whose core sense is tiziri; moonlight (amazigh).

faq.question: What is the origin of Tiziri?
faq.answer: Tiziri is associated with Amazigh. Tiziri is Amazigh (Berber), meaning 'moonlight'.

faq.question: Is Tiziri an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Amazigh, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Tiziri an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Tiziri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Amazigh-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Tiziri a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Tiziri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Tiziri is an Amazigh word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Tiziri, tiziri. Script forms are تيزيري, تِيزِيرِي, تیزیری, तिज़ीरी.
